status: Current unified Nature figure contract; historical configurations preserved separately

integration.check_trigger: Explicit freeze command only; normal rendering/export remains unchanged. Agent prepares/stylizes the candidate; the gate validates and publishes its manifest.
integration.historical_gid_policy: Preserve old IDs as aliases; add scientific mappings without using autogenerated artist order as scientific identity.
integration.sidecar_policy: Extend the existing artist_registry contract when integrating; do not create a second competing exporter.

physical_layout.width_status: Available journal size; actual width selected by composition under presentation.rules.journal.dimensions
physical_layout.svg_scale_policy: Record source-to-final scale; compensate source text and strokes so effective final sizes match. Nonuniform scaling requires resolution before freeze.

colors.condition_source: ConditionSpec.color_rgb_255 via condition_color(); preserve assay identity for each matched control

typography.alternative_policy: explicit recorded profile change; never machine-dependent fallback

continuous_trace.shared_x_labels: bottom axes only; retain data-coordinate mappings on all axes

boxed_heatmap.shared_axes: Suppress repeated labels/tick labels where shared; do not remove the enclosing box.
boxed_heatmap.colorbar_sharing: Only identical measure, units, normalization and limits may share a colorbar.

trial_ratio.uncertainty_definition_source: saved analysis sidecar; do not infer from fill style

schematic.stimulus_shape_policy: Retain scientific symbol geometry; use stimulus colors and typography roles. Short/long US and catch distinctions remain semantic metadata.

background.panel.meaning: Non-data figure or axes background; explicit canvas/axes coordinate mapping and fill, no scientific measure.

stimulus.cs.onset.meaning: Conditioned stimulus begins; record measured or protocol timing.

stimulus.cs.offset.meaning: Conditioned stimulus ends; distinct from onset and expected US.

stimulus.us.actual.meaning: Recorded unconditioned stimulus event; event-source mapping required.

stimulus.us.expected.meaning: Protocol expectation; never label as a measured event without evidence.

stimulus.window.meaning: Stimulus interval; record CS/US kind and duration.

stimulus.symbol.meaning: Schematic CS/US, short/long pulse or CS-only catch; record symbol kind.

baseline.window.meaning: Scientific reference interval; bounds come from selected analysis.

reference.time.zero.meaning: Time-coordinate origin; record the alignment event, commonly CS onset.

reference.signal.zero.meaning: Zero of the identified signal/transformed measure; record its definition.

reference.response_ratio.equal_baseline.meaning: Response divided by baseline equals one; not zero-centered signal.

trace.tail_angle.meaning: Measured tail angle; record radians/degrees and any centering.

trace.raw_vigor.meaning: Untransformed measured activity; record metric and units.

trace.heatmap_bin_overlay.meaning: Exact saved heatmap-bin values on an explicitly identified axis; gaps remain missing.

trajectory.fish.meaning: Repeated measurements from one fish; retain pairing identity.

observation.fish.meaning: Fish observation; record fish, condition, trial/block and measure.

summary.curve.meaning: Identified aggregation/estimator across fish or trials.

summary.median.meaning: Median of an explicitly identified population.

uncertainty.iqr.meaning: Q25-Q75 of the identified population; not a confidence interval.

uncertainty.confidence_interval.meaning: CI; record level, method, resampling unit and pointwise/simultaneous coverage. Line constituents use summary_curve thickness with alpha 0.2.

heatmap.vigor.meaning: Vigor representation; metric, aggregation, normalization and limits are required.

heatmap.coverage.meaning: Observation/fish coverage; record numerator, denominator and its own scale.

colorbar.scale.meaning: Color-to-value scale linked to its mappable element IDs.

phase.separator.heatmap.meaning: Boundary between named session phases on a heatmap.

phase.boundary.meaning: Session transition on a trace/ratio/schematic; record actual trial boundary.

phase.label.meaning: Named Pre/Train/Test or detailed session phase.

annotation.example_trial.meaning: Selected illustrative fish/trial; record selection source and status.

axes.container.meaning: Data or colorbar axes with explicit coordinate/quantity context.

axis.component.meaning: Identified x/y axis and its quantity, units and transform.

axis.tick.meaning: Tick mark; dimension, side, major/minor kind and value required.

axis.tick_label.meaning: Displayed tick text; retain numeric value/category separately from formatting.

axis.label.meaning: Quantity/unit label of an identified axis.

axis.spine.meaning: Axes boundary; record side and visibility.

title.panel.meaning: Panel title; condition-specific heading uses condition_title style.

title.condition.meaning: Assay/condition heading; retain matched control identity.

label.panel_letter.meaning: Assembly panel identifier, independent of scientific role.

legend.key.meaning: Legend group with referenced scientific roles; glyphs use their underlying role styles.

annotation.statistical_comparison.meaning: Within/between-group contrast linked to saved result and comparison endpoints.

annotation.statistical_label.meaning: Computed significance/result text; retain test, correction, p-value and scientific status.

annotation.note.meaning: Scientific/presentation note, including clipping or provisional status.

schematic.preparation.meaning: Apparatus, fish, basal illumination or protocol structure; retain authored geometry.

trace.scaled_vigor_series.meaning: Framewise measured vigor after the explicitly recorded baseline subtraction and scaling; raw frames or log frames and normalization must be named. Not a binned series unless declared.

element_record_contract.id_policy: Use lowercase XML-safe components and scientific instance keys, never the global artist index. Include condition/fish/trial/axis/tick kind/value as needed for uniqueness.
element_record_contract.scientific_context_policy: Use explicit not-applicable values for structural elements; scientific marks carry applicable metric, units, condition/cohort, fish/trial/block, data fields, alignment, aggregation, normalization, missingness and any nonfinite-value display rules. Negative-infinite scientific lower bounds must not be silently treated as NaN missingness.
element_record_contract.freeze_classification_policy: Accept explicit/high only with evidence; never infer event identity from appearance. Low/unknown remains unresolved.
element_record_contract.style_verification_policy: Properties not measured directly in SVG require per-property {status: passed, evidence: ...}; currently cmap, missing_color, color_source, zorder, padding, facecolor, grid, legend frame and statistical end caps. Embedded images additionally require raster_content review. Semantic color sources also require resolved_color and color_evidence.
element_record_contract.composite_policy: Group median marker/connecting line/IQR stems/caps under one composite_id; retain a distinct unique ID and role for each serialized artist.
element_record_contract.coincident_role_policy: One artist may have additional scientific_roles, for example CS onset at time zero. The specific stimulus style takes precedence over generic reference style; do not draw duplicate coincident guides.
element_record_contract.opacity_policy: Record artist alpha and color RGBA alpha separately, plus effective exported fill/stroke opacity after backend resolution. Do not assume alpha=None is transparent or multiply values that Matplotlib overrides.

exception_record_contract.scope_policy: Explicit figure/panel/subpanel/element IDs, applicable revision or future use, and decision date; never implicitly extend a panel approval across the paper.
exception_record_contract.approval_policy: Cite an explicit author instruction/decision and reuse within scope. Observed renderer values and visual similarity alone do not grant approval.
exception_record_contract.scientific_definition_policy: Metric, units, normalization, event timing, baseline bounds, estimator and inference choices belong in scientific_context, not style exceptions.

freeze_record_contract.verification_policy: Each required review is {status: passed, evidence: ...}, bound to the hashed candidate and artifacts. Evidence records actual completed review, never a generated assertion of approval.
freeze_record_contract.original_svg_policy: Exactly one source_artifacts entry has kind=original_svg: the selected unstyled SVG at the same assembly geometry. The gate compares protected geometry/resources/ancestor transforms to it. Assemble before making the style-only candidate; freeze panels separately or provide one assembled SVG.
freeze_record_contract.unresolved_exception_policy: Prepare independent review work, ask targeted questions interactively, and do not finalize while a required decision is pending. Noninteractive tools must return an unresolved-exception report and failure status.
freeze_record_contract.integrity_policy: Hash actual final bytes. Preserve existing embedded-sidecar SVG integrity conventions to avoid circular self-hashes; store final export hashes in the separate freeze manifest.
freeze_record_contract.authorization_policy: A user request to freeze is authorization; do not seek redundant approval after all exceptions are resolved.

historical_artifact_policy: Inventory appearances as evidence. Do not restyle, refreeze, rewrite hashes or classify old artifacts as compliant without an explicit new request and verification.

author_selection.scope: Future main, supplementary and analysis figures and panels; current drafts unchanged
author_selection.source: Author reply in this chat to the spacing calibration question

presentation.scope: Nature main research artwork; explicit opt-in, no current-artwork migration

value.palette: accessible choices; example palette is not compulsory

value.scale_bars: separate editable layer; not magnification factors
value.adjustments: whole image, equally to matched controls
value.discrete_heatmaps: preserve authenticated cells; do not apply photographic DPI blindly
value.generative_imagery: preserve authentic assets; conflicting/evolving AI guidance requires source review

value.title: brief whole-figure title
value.methods: shared Methods, no loss of definitions
value.production: separate from artwork in manuscript text

value.measurement: painted glyph bounds through final transforms; renderer padding is not evidence

value.headings: center over own data rectangle; distinguish experiment from condition

value.tick_count_and_values: preserve selected scientific coordinates; no universal count or zero-origin rule

value.tokens: contract.colors; scientific series from ConditionSpec and selected sources
value.alpha_and_layering: inherit identified role styles; inspect resolved composites
value.palette_changes: scoped candidate; authenticated raster bytes remain protected

value.format: selected native SVG plus legend in self-contained scoped HTML

pilot_measurements_required: marker diameter and edge width per role
key symbol size and symbol-text spacing
effective opacity and visibility at final size
value.scientific_scope: scoped selections remain authoritative; inherited legacy plot families are not selected scientific definitions
value.render_evidence: required; policy resolution and theme application do not certify a figure
